title: Aston Villa 3-2 Paris Saint-Germain, 2025
pool: Aston Villa's starting XI against Paris Saint-Germain at Villa Park, 15 April 2025 — the Champions League quarter-final second leg. Villa won on the night and went out 5-4 on aggregate.
_notes: CORRECTED. This board first had Kamara and Tielemans as the holding pair
with Onana wide right. That came from reading the source through a
summarising model, which grouped the lines wrongly. The page's own markup,
fetched raw, lists the XI in pitch order:
23 Martinez | 2 Cash, 4 Konsa, 14 Torres, 12 Digne | 44 Kamara, 24 Onana
So the holding pair is KAMARA and ONANA, and TIELEMANS plays in the three.
Sky lists each line right to left — Cash is the right-back and is named
first, Digne is the left-back and is named last — so the order here is that
listing reversed, which is what puts the tiles on the correct side.
Left-to-right within the attacking three is the one thing the source does
not state outright; it follows from the same right-to-left convention the
back four proves. The band each player occupies, which is the part that
carries the clue, is read directly off the page.
Nationalities are not on the match page and come from the club's season
This board cannot be checked by research/tools/verify_lineups.mjs — its
source is Sky rather than a Wikipedia match report, so it was read by hand.
